body: we need a flow course from you I think.

I think if you want to be safe you should:
- compute MD5 for images
- replace in CSS, JS, HTML
- compute MD5 for CSS
- replace in JS, HTML
- compute MD5 FOR JS
- replace in HTML

This way you should be safe. Maybe from our setup this is already safe the way you did it?
It is already safe since we want to remove cache from assets, but it would more "correct" to do it the way you describe. Go for it 👍
